Tender (2017-18) Project
Saturday, 15 July 2017
6208 Hits
The Head of Dept. of Microbiology, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram invites sealed tenders for the following item/s under project "Capacity Building and Strengthening of Hospital Infection Control to detect and prevent antimicrobial resistance in India under AIIMS-ICMR". The tenders in sealed envelope superscribed with name of the item and Department should be submitted in the office of “Dept. of Microbiology, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram, Maharashtra 442102” latest by 20/07/2017 up to 3.00 PM.
Tender forms can be obtained by sending email to ‘
centralstore@mgims.ac.in
’ or can be downloaded from the institute website (www.mgims.ac.in).
The Purchase Committee reserves the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason.
Microbiology Department (Project):
1) Automated Blood Culture System
Tender Document
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
